metadata.description: VAREK for Microsoft Sentinel (v1.40): analytics rules on VarekOCSF_CL (a refusal, a failed audit, a dry run's let-through calls) and a workbook, in the Sentinel workspace. Deploy azuredeploy.json first: it makes the table.
The workspace Microsoft Sentinel is on, with VarekOCSF_CL (azuredeploy.json).

content.json:
## VAREK: the Warden's decisions
Refusals by policy line, agent and run; what dry runs let through; failed audits. The rows are OCSF 1.9.0 events in `VarekOCSF_CL`, sent by `varek export --format sentinel`.

content.query:
VarekOCSF_CL
| where "{Run}" == "*" or RunId == "{Run}"
| summarize Refused = countif(Decision == "DENY" and Mode != "dry_run"), Decisions = countif(isnotempty(Decision)), Runs = dcount(RunId), ["Let through in dry runs"] = countif(Mode == "dry_run"), ["Failed audits"] = countif(EventName == "varek.audit" and AuditPassed == false)
| evaluate narrow()
| project Count = toint(Value), Name = Column
content.title: Counts

content.query:
VarekOCSF_CL
| where Decision == "DENY" and Mode != "dry_run"
| where "{Run}" == "*" or RunId == "{Run}"
| extend DecidedBy = iff(PolicyLine > 0, strcat("line ", tostring(PolicyLine), ": ", PolicyText), Rule)
| summarize Refused = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), DecidedBy
content.title: Refusals over time, by what decided them

items.name: Refusals over time, by what decided them

content.query:
VarekOCSF_CL
| where Decision == "DENY" and Mode != "dry_run"
| where "{Run}" == "*" or RunId == "{Run}"
| extend DecidedBy = iff(PolicyLine > 0, strcat("line ", tostring(PolicyLine), ": ", PolicyText), Rule)
| summarize Refused = count(), Runs = dcount(RunId), Targets = make_set(Target, 10), Last = max(TimeGenerated) by DecidedBy
| order by Refused desc
content.title: Refusals by policy line (or the rule, for a default deny)

items.name: Refusals by policy line (or the rule, for a default deny)

content.query:
VarekOCSF_CL
| where Decision == "DENY" and Mode != "dry_run"
| where "{Run}" == "*" or RunId == "{Run}"
| extend DecidedBy = iff(PolicyLine > 0, strcat("line ", tostring(PolicyLine), ": ", PolicyText), Rule)
| summarize Refused = count(), ["Policy lines"] = dcount(DecidedBy) by Agent = coalesce(Agent, "(the agent)")
| order by Refused desc
content.title: Refusals by agent

content.query:
VarekOCSF_CL
| where "{Run}" == "*" or RunId == "{Run}"
| summarize Refused = countif(Decision == "DENY" and Mode != "dry_run"), Decisions = countif(isnotempty(Decision)), ["Dry run, let through"] = countif(Mode == "dry_run"), Audit = take_anyif(iff(AuditPassed, "passed", "FAILED"), EventName == "varek.audit"), Start = min(TimeGenerated), End = max(TimeGenerated), Policy = take_any(PolicyName) by RunId, Computer
| order by End desc
content.title: Runs

content.query:
VarekOCSF_CL
| where Decision == "DENY" and Mode != "dry_run"
| where "{Run}" == "*" or RunId == "{Run}"
| extend DecidedBy = iff(PolicyLine > 0, strcat("line ", tostring(PolicyLine), ": ", PolicyText), Rule)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Agent, ClassName, ActivityName, Target, Verdict, DecidedBy, RunId, ReportId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
content.title: Latest refusals

content.query:
VarekOCSF_CL
| where "{Run}" == "*" or RunId == "{Run}"
| where Mode == "dry_run"
| extend DecidedBy = iff(PolicyLine > 0, strcat("line ", tostring(PolicyLine), ": ", PolicyText), Rule)
| summarize Count = count() by DecidedBy, Target
| order by Count desc
content.title: Dry runs: what the policy refuses, let through and recorded

items.name: Dry runs: what the policy refuses, let through and recorded

content.query:
VarekOCSF_CL
| where "{Run}" == "*" or RunId == "{Run}"
| where EventName == "varek.audit" and AuditPassed == false
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, RunId, Mode = tostring(OcsfEvent.unmapped.varek.audit.mode), Problems = tostring(OcsfEvent.unmapped.varek.audit.problems)
content.title: Failed audits

properties.description: The VAREK Warden refused an agent's action: the run, the agent, what it tried and the policy line (or the rule, for a default deny) that refused it. One alert for each run, agent and policy line in the period.
properties.query:
VarekOCSF_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) and ingestion_time() > ago(5m) and ingestion_time() <= now()
| where Decision == "DENY" and Mode != "dry_run"
| extend DecidedBy = iff(PolicyLine > 0, strcat("line ", tostring(PolicyLine), ": ", PolicyText), Rule)
| summarize TimeGenerated = max(TimeGenerated), Refused = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Targets = make_set(Target, 20), Verdicts = make_set(Verdict) by RunId, Computer, Agent, DecidedBy, PolicyName

properties.description: The audit of a VAREK run's verdict stream failed: the stream is not the Warden's as it wrote it (a record changed, missing or forged), or its policy is not the one it names. The run's events cannot be trusted.
properties.query:
VarekOCSF_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) and ingestion_time() > ago(5m) and ingestion_time() <= now()
| where EventName == "varek.audit" and AuditPassed == false
| extend Problems = tostring(OcsfEvent.unmapped.varek.audit.problems), AuditMode = tostring(OcsfEvent.unmapped.varek.audit.mode)
| project TimeGenerated, RunId, Computer, AuditMode, Problems

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: VAREK: the audit of run {{RunId}} on {{Computer}} failed

properties.displayName: VAREK: a dry run let through what its policy refuses
properties.description: A VAREK dry run (NOT ENFORCING) let through calls its policy refuses, and recorded them. Expected while a policy is drafted (varek policy suggest); not where runs are meant to be enforced.
properties.query:
VarekOCSF_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) and ingestion_time() > ago(5m) and ingestion_time() <= now()
| where Mode == "dry_run"
| extend DecidedBy = iff(PolicyLine > 0, strcat("line ", tostring(PolicyLine), ": ", PolicyText), Rule)
| summarize TimeGenerated = max(TimeGenerated), LetThrough = count(), Targets = make_set(Target, 20) by RunId, Computer, Agent, DecidedBy

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: VAREK dry run on {{Computer}} let through: {{DecidedBy}}
